title: 1.2 Plate Tectonics Theory
description: The lithosphere, asthenosphere, major plates, and the development of plate tectonic theory. Easy level.

questions.question: Which layer allows the lithosphere to slide across the top of it?
options: The North American Plate
At plate boundaries
In the late 1960s
The asthenosphere

questions.question: What does the lithosphere consist of?
options: Earthquakes and volcanic eruptions
Its ductility, which allows slow flow
The crust and the uppermost mantle
Continental rocks, oceanic rocks, or both
questions.correctAnswer: The crust and the uppermost mantle

questions.question: About how many large plates make up the lithosphere?
options: About a dozen
The asthenosphere
In the late 1960s
At plate boundaries

questions.question: At what rate do tectonic plates typically move?
options: They move slowly and change size
A few centimeters per year
A large piece of the lithosphere
The crust and the uppermost mantle

questions.question: When was plate tectonic theory developed?
options: At plate boundaries
The North American Plate
In the late 1960s
The asthenosphere

questions.question: What is a tectonic plate?
options: Its ductility, which allows slow flow
The crust and the uppermost mantle
They move slowly and change size
A large piece of the lithosphere
questions.correctAnswer: A large piece of the lithosphere

questions.question: Where do plates meet one another?
options: The North American Plate
At plate boundaries
The asthenosphere
A few centimeters per year

questions.question: What types of rock can make up a tectonic plate?
options: Continental rocks, oceanic rocks, or both
Beneath an ocean rather than along a coastline
The distribution of fossils and the ages of rocks
It is the rigid shell broken into moving plates
questions.correctAnswer: Continental rocks, oceanic rocks, or both

questions.question: Which plate includes the western half of the North Atlantic seafloor?
options: A few centimeters per year
They move slowly and change size
A large piece of the lithosphere
The North American Plate

questions.question: Where may plate boundaries be located?
options: It explains rock ages and fossil distribution patterns
Ocean basins can expand or shrink over geologic time
Lithospheric plates move laterally over a weaker layer
Beneath an ocean rather than along a coastline
questions.correctAnswer: Beneath an ocean rather than along a coastline
